decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposal, by way of its position, design and appearance and will not harm the living conditions in the adjoining properties or the surrounding area. The development is therefore considered to be in accordance with Adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan; and is compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as No. 19, Hibernia Road and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or, separate dwelling or for business use)
Condition : 6 - The two windows proposed for the rear elevation will contain obscure gazing.
description: Erection of a single storey detached building in rear end of garden to house to be used as a store.
